snippet.title: Big Farm Story - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Begin a new chapter in life in Big Farm Story! 

When your grandpa mysteriously gifts you his old farm, it's your chance to write your own story. Rebuild the farm to its former glory, plant, harvest, and take care of all your animals. Discover a small village and meet new friends around each corner.

Enjoy this farm adventure on Steam, Humble Bundle, the Microsoft Store and Nintendo Switch!
